Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product Velvet Bows Christmas Tree Decorations
Quantity 24 Pieces
Material Premium Velvet + Satin Ribbon

Use For Christmas Tree / Wreaths / Gifts / Mantel Décor
 Perfect For
 Christmas Tree Décor — 24 bows elevate the whole tree instantly
 Gift Toppers — Tied on boxes, thoughtful and beautiful
 Wreath Accents — Paired with frosted pinecones for magazine-worthy appeal
 Mantel Styling — Layered with candles and lights for extra warmth
 Window & Wall Accents — Refined details for festive displays
 DIY Projects — Blend into your own creative arrangements
 Holiday Gifting — The perfect present for festive friends and family
 Care & Usage Tips
Hanging: Use the pre-attached satin loops — hang on branches, hooks or ribbons
Styling Tip: Cluster camel bows among frosted pinecones for a designer-magazine look
Cleaning: Dust with a dry cloth; avoid washing
Storage: Store in a box after the season, away from heavy pressure

Velvet Luxury, a Designer-Look Christmas Tree Crafted from premium velvet and satin ribbon, each bow is full, crisp and softly lustrous — like draping your tree in a cashmere throw. Understated elegance that gets more beautiful the longer you look.

1-Inch Velvet Ribbon, Crisp Shape That Holds The 1-inch-wide velvet ribbon gives each bow a delicate yet durable structure that keeps its elegant shape all season long — no sagging, no flattening, just refined form.
24 Bows with Pre-Attached Satin Loops, Ready to Hang A set of 24, each with a pre-attached satin loop — unbox and hang directly on branches. No extra supplies needed; upgrade your entire tree in minutes.
Dust-Resistant & Easy to Clean, Fresh Year After Year The dust-resistant surface wipes clean with a dry cloth — effortless upkeep. Pack them away after the season and bring them out again next Christmas. One purchase, years of holiday charm.
A Thoughtful Gift, Loved by Friends & Family Beautiful, high-quality and endlessly useful — for friends, family or anyone who loves festive styling, it's the safest and most heartfelt gift of the season.

8956086440723.sourceDescription:
Twenty blank wooden deer heads with twenty pieces of twine. The shape is cut from solid wood and left bare, so it can be painted, stained or written on.

Each head is 8.9 x 7.3 cm with a hole at the top for hanging, and the surface is sanded smooth. They work as ornaments, gift tags, place names or part of a garland, and they take acrylic paint and marker without priming. A little clear varnish keeps the edges from furring after handling. Twenty in the pack, so a tree can take a set without running short.

Small parts, so keep them away from children who still put things in their mouths.

Material: Wood

5037204458523.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Canvas. Product measurements: length 1 cm, width 30 cm, height 30 cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Self-adhesive backing allows for quick and easy application to any compatible surface without the need for additional tools or hardware.
Crafted from durable canvas material, ensuring the festive design remains vibrant and intact throughout the holiday season.
Compact single set design adds a charming focal point to your Christmas display while maintaining a proportionate aesthetic.
Versatile decorative detail suitable for enhancing various home settings, allowing flexible arrangement within your seasonal decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: Self Adhesive backing

5056797098923.sourceDescription:
Bring a frosty touch to your Christmas display with this 61 x 63cm LED snowflake from MySmartBuy. It has 196 white micro LEDs on a sturdy metal frame, with a 20% flashing effect for extra sparkle. Hang it on a wall, fence, porch or entrance. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 61 x 63cm snowflake | 196 white micro LEDs | 20% flashing | metal frame | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.

STURDY METAL FRAME : Built for outdoor display.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Gardens, walls, fences, porches and entrances.

Openwork pattern: Delicate star-shaped details situated across the openwork structure add subtle visual depth and decorative interest to the main star.
Spiral base: A sturdy spiral wire base fitted underneath ensures stable and balanced positioning over a suitable top branch of your tree.
Generous width: Measuring 350 mm across, this festive star topper provides prominent visual impact without overpowering surrounding baubles and ornaments.
Lightweight construction: With an unpackaged weight of only 100 g, the topper rests securely without weighing down tree branches during seasonal display.
Indoor celebrations: Perfectly suited for indoor domestic Christmas trees, seasonal gatherings and festive holiday parties with friends and visiting family.
Single pack supply: Supplied as one individual Christmas tree topper, ready to coordinate effortlessly with gold, red, white or metallic ornaments.

5096042275723.baseName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Fabric craft kit - Reindeer and vintage patchwork for a Christmas craft afternoon - 20 x 20 cm
5096042275723.variantName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Fabric craft kit - Reindeer and vintage patchwork for a Christmas craft afternoon - 20 x 20 cm
5096042275723.sourceDescription:
Build a small multicoloured wreath around a reindeer motif. The pre-cut, perforated fabric takes some of the preparation out of the project and the overlapping pieces give the finished decoration depth. The decoration measures 20 x 20 cm.

Patchwork brings together the softness of the cloth and the definition of a picture. Each section contributes to a larger shape, so progress is visible as you go and the finished decoration retains the small variations of handwork. A plain surface gives individual colours room to show. For a coordinated arrangement elsewhere in the room, pick out just one of those colours for ribbon or a small group of ornaments.

The prepared shapes make it easier to compare adjoining pieces before fixing them. Lay out a small group at a time, keeping the rest together so that similarly coloured pieces remain easy to identify. Begin with the broad shapes and keep the smaller details together until you reach their place in the design. Seeing the outline develop first makes it easier to judge how the finished piece will look on a wall.

Before putting the decoration away, let the textile layers settle into their natural positions. Support the shape from below when lifting it and allow enough space above the fabric to keep its raised appearance.

For a shared craft afternoon, one person can sort the next colours while another works on the current section.

To give the finished work as a present, choose a box deep enough to leave the decorated face clear of the lid. A handwritten gift tag can say who made it and when, a small detail that turns the project into a keepsake. Lay the finished piece face up when you put it away. A shallow box with enough room for the edges helps preserve the work and lets you bring it out again without first having to reshape the front.
Pre-cut and pre-punched fabric pieces simplify the patchwork process for a quick and enjoyable craft session.
Features a charming reindeer motif with vintage-style multicoloured fabric layers for a textured, decorative finish.
Compact 20 x 20 cm design is perfect for small spaces, wall display, or as a handmade gift keepsake.
Ideal for a relaxing Christmas craft afternoon, bringing together soft cloth textures and clear picture definition.
Comes with Pre-cut, perforated fabric pieces

Balloons will arrive uninflated and will need to be inflated using air (reusable inflation tube to blow through included).

After the party, please use a plastic reusable inflation tube to export the air for reuse
These balloons are great supplies for birthday parties, weddings, baby showers, outdoor parties, home parties, celebrations and other on-site decorations. A great birthday party decoration for the babies, kids, and adults

5037204473823.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Red. Product measurements: height 243 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Inflatable Santa decoration adds a festive focal point to your Christmas display.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif in vibrant red fabric.
Designed for easy placement and coordination with other seasonal decor.
Includes one piece of durable fabric construction for lasting use.
Guarantee - 1 month

Brighten your festive décor with this 68cm collapsible LED Santa decoration. Featuring 30 warm white LEDs, a sturdy wireframe, and tinsel-effect fabric, it creates a warm and welcoming glow indoors or outdoors. The built-in 6-hour on / 18-hour off timer offers effortless daily lighting, while the battery-powered design (3 x AA, not included) keeps setup simple and wire-free.

Its clever pop-up design assembles in seconds and collapses flat for easy storage after the holidays. Perfect for doorways, gardens, porches, or hallways, this Santa figure adds an instant festive touch with minimal effort.

Specifications:
• Character: Santa
• Size: 68cm H x 50cm W
• Lights: 30 Warm White LEDs
• Timer: 6h ON / 18h OFF
• Power: 3 x AA Batteries (Not Included)
• Use: Indoor & Outdoor (IP44)
• Assembly: Collapsible Pop-Up
